title_zh: 香港港：曾经的世界第一大港
title_en: China's Ports (9/20): Hong Kong, Once the World's Busiest Port
note_en: 虽然 ... 依然/仍然 and 尽管 ... 仍然 pair a concession with a contrast, where English uses just one word: 虽然近年来吞吐量被内地港口超过，香港港依然是重要的国际转运中心 "Although mainland ports have overtaken it..., Hong Kong remains..." English says "although" and stops; Chinese normally marks the second clause too, with 但是, 依然, 仍然 or 还, and saying "although ... but" is perfectly correct in Chinese.
